name: Nolle Prosequi
overview: The account of Gallio's refusal to judge the complaint against Paul demonstrates a principle of wise discernment in legal matters, distinguishing between moral wrongdoing and disputes over religious doctrine. When the Jews accused Paul of persuading men to worship God contrary to the law, Gallio recognized that the issue involved words and names rather than criminal acts, and therefore he dismissed the case and drove them from the judgment seat. This incident highlights God's providence in protecting His servant and affirms that not all accusations against believers warrant human judgment, especially when they concern matters of faith and conscience.
